user.title: Connect to Matter Hub
user.description:
Enter the address of the Matter Hub web interface.

The Matter Hub app uses the host network, so it has no separate hostname on the Supervisor network. Unless you changed the port, it listens on 8482. On this system that is usually {example_url}. If that name does not resolve, use the IP address of this Home Assistant with the same port. Open the Matter Hub panel in the sidebar if you need to confirm the port. This integration connects to that address directly.

Docker and standalone Matter Hub use the host and port where you published the web interface, also 8482 by default.

A username and password are only needed when authentication is turned on in Matter Hub. Installing Matter Hub: {project_url}.

init.title: Enter the Matter Hub address
init.description:
Matter Bridge no longer reaches {title} through a Home Assistant ingress session, so the integration is not loaded. Ingress sessions belong to a logged-in user, and an integration cannot create one.

Enter the Matter Hub address to keep using this same integration. Its devices, entity names and automations stay.

The Matter Hub app uses the host network and port 8482, so on this system the address is usually {example_url}. If that name does not resolve, use the IP address of this Home Assistant with the same port. Docker and standalone installs use the host and port where Matter Hub is published.

Leave the username and password blank to keep ones already saved. Pairing codes are shown in the Matter Hub web interface, which the link on the service opens once this is running. See {project_url}.
